storage_reservation_basis: Small dual-encoder checkpoints with six critic/Adam states, 6400 scalar gradient/constraint log records, epoch references, and 32 private gradient normalization tensor draws; 256 MiB is a conservative reservation, not measured output size.
RSS_status: No pilot peak measured; source admission peak was below 0.5 GiB but does not certify training peak.
budget_rule: Reserve independently verified diagnostics and closeout before optional pilot. ROOT uses queued engineering timing and remaining campaign budget to decide whether both complete source-seed workers fit; do not infer feasibility solely from unit counts. Queue timeouts preserve incomplete attempts rather than claiming completion.
